rationale: Despite gapping down on an earnings miss and a heavily bearish macro environment (SPY -2.28%, VIXY +16.03%), PINS is showing strong intraday relative strength, trading well above VWAP ($18.59) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($18.85) near the top of its range. Going long directly opposes both the negative fundamental catalyst and severe broad market selling pressure, while going short fights clear intraday buyer control and upward price momentum. With conflicting signals between the macro/fundamental backdrop and intraday price action, there is no high-probability edge in either direction.
